status: superseded first-pass stats snapshot; preserve for source comparison
defense_formula: Physical resistance = min(75, 100 * final armor / (100 + final armor) + direct physical resistance pp).
equipment_order: Scale unit base by level, add like equipment percentages within their layer, add flat armor/range/structure and resistance/crit pp, derive resistance once and apply caps. Procs are separate.

entities.name: Swordsman
entities.identity: Keep the generalist and cleave; distinct from Militia bodies and Maceman armor break.

entities.name: Archer
entities.identity: Keep cheap single-shot ranged support and volley; Longbowman trades tempo for charged shots.

entities.name: Shield Knight
entities.identity: Add a limited allied projectile interception stance; Lantern Guard remains the durable splash fighter.

entities.name: Spearman
entities.identity: Keep reach and armor-ignoring thrust; Pikeman specializes in braced charge interception.

entities.name: Crossbowman
entities.identity: Keep quick precision shots and farthest-target special; Longbowman has a charged opening and poor mobility.

entities.name: Cavalry Rider
entities.identity: Keep the line charge; Outrider intercepts defensively and Mounted Archer fires while moving.

entities.name: Siege Engineer
entities.identity: Keep wagon repair and add one temporary repairable bolt emplacement; Runesmith specializes in allied wards and constructed objects.

entities.name: Mage
entities.identity: Make Arcane Beam pierce a line; Stormcaller owns chained hits between enemies.

entities.name: Halberdier
entities.identity: Keep melee siege damage and sweep; Wardbreaker removes magical protection rather than physical armor.

entities.name: Alchemist
entities.identity: Keep direct lobbed splash with a short splash-debuff special; Firepot Thrower owns lasting ground fire. Correct burning-ground lore unless intentionally added.

entities.name: Battle Monk
entities.identity: Keep a combat aura and periodic area healing; Field Medic is the dedicated single-patient healer.

entities.name: War Hound
entities.identity: Keep cheapest fast expendable scout; Militia adds two slower bodies at higher total cost.

entities.name: Banner Knight
entities.identity: Keep nearby offensive aura and rally; Chanter improves ability recovery rather than passive damage.

entities.name: Necromancer
entities.identity: Implement corpse-token conversion into capped temporary allied Risen; no tokens or resource refunds from summoned bodies.

entities.name: Rogue
entities.identity: Keep backline targeting and a true next-strike Vanish bonus; Duelist owns defensive melee parries.

entities.name: Berserker
entities.identity: Keep missing-health damage; implement real attack recovery acceleration for frenzy.

entities.name: Lantern Guard
entities.identity: Keep splash and toughness; replace duplicated Shield Wall special with a short defensive sweep that protects its own position.

entities.name: Ballista Crew
entities.identity: Keep mobile structure-hitting bolts; replace duplicated Snipe with a marked armor-piercing siege shot.

entities.name: Stormcaller
entities.identity: Make ordinary attacks or special chain through a limited number of packed enemies; do not reuse Mage beam.

entities.name: Risen
entities.identity: Retain the basic teaching enemy.

entities.name: Ghoul
entities.identity: Retain fast fragile pressure.

entities.name: Rot Hulk
entities.identity: Retain death blast; use a clearly labeled variant only if enabling enemy collateral damage.

entities.name: Grave Brute
entities.identity: Retain the uncomplicated heavy melee body.

entities.name: Blight Caster
entities.identity: Retain ordinary ranged pressure; specialized blight belongs to Miasma Priest.

entities.name: Bone Nest
entities.identity: Retain two-body death split; split bodies are not corpse-token or reward farms.

entities.name: Sapper
entities.identity: Retain wagon rush; correct suicide-bomber lore or add a separately telegraphed one-use strike.

entities.name: Dread Herald
entities.identity: Retain passive nearby damage/movement buff; War Drummer uses interruptible attack tempo instead.

entities.name: Hexer
entities.identity: Retain global deployment disruption with its recovery window; Null Magister uses a local field.

entities.name: Bone Juggernaut
entities.identity: Retain a readable physical tank; adopt explicit armor once counters are taught.

entities.name: Shield Wall
entities.identity: Retain formation projectile interception.

entities.name: Lich
entities.identity: Retain periodic simple reinforcements; Bone Cantor requires corpse tokens and channels for an elite.

entities.name: Siege Tower
entities.identity: Retain the moving reinforcement carrier.

entities.name: Mirror Knight
entities.identity: Retain general direct-damage reflection; Thorn Brute reflects only contact in a visible stance.

entities.name: Tunneler
entities.identity: Retain movement behind the rearmost troop; Cliff Stalker selects ranged-primary targets and telegraphs a leap.

entities.name: Bone Ballista
entities.identity: Retain long-range ordinary artillery.

entities.name: Catacomb Giant
entities.identity: Retain splash melee and three-body death split.

entities.name: Revenant Captain
entities.identity: Add a periodic visible escort rally instead of only a different Herald stat profile.

entities.name: Plague Engine
entities.identity: Retain heavy artillery; optionally add a short marked blight patch after the status system exists.

entities.name: Militia
entities.identity: Two fragile levy soldiers deploy together; one card cooldown and one courage payment.

entities.name: Maceman
entities.identity: Every third committed hit briefly breaks armor on one target.

entities.name: Field Medic
entities.identity: Prioritizes one injured ally and channels repeated healing instead of attacking.

entities.name: Longbowman
entities.identity: Charges a powerful straight shot while stationary; loses charge when displaced.

entities.name: Javelin Skirmisher
entities.identity: Throws once, retreats a short distance, then commits to melee.

entities.name: Quartermaster
entities.identity: Nearby allied kills earn small courage packets on a shared cooldown.

entities.name: Iron Sentinel
entities.identity: Braces while stationary and redirects a capped part of nearby allies' direct damage to itself.

entities.name: Firepot Thrower
entities.identity: Lobs pots that leave short-lived burning patches.

entities.name: Runesmith
entities.identity: Places temporary wards on allies; repairs nearby player-built tactical objects.

entities.name: Flame Adept
entities.identity: Sweeps a short cone of flame, applying capped burn stacks to clustered enemies.

entities.name: Plague Doctor
entities.identity: Cleanses blight and healing reduction from one ally, with modest recovery.

entities.name: Flagellant
entities.identity: On death, grants a brief rally to nearby living allies; never triggers from revived or summoned copies.

entities.name: Paladin
entities.identity: After protecting a wounded ally, charges one radiant strike and an ally shield.

entities.name: Pikeman
entities.identity: Braces against a telegraphed charge and interrupts the first charger reaching its spear tip.

entities.name: Trapper
entities.identity: Leaves visible snares behind its advance, with at most two active traps.

entities.name: Earthshaper
entities.identity: Raises a temporary stone obstacle and sends a slow ground shock through packed enemies.

entities.name: Gravebound Knight
entities.identity: Returns once after death with reduced health and permanently reduced speed.

entities.name: Spirit Keeper
entities.identity: Stores limited charges from nearby allied deaths and spends them to shield living allies.

entities.name: Wardbreaker
entities.identity: Melee strikes remove temporary magical wards; its special interrupts a channel.

entities.name: Druid
entities.identity: Grows a small healing grove and a root patch that slows ground enemies.

entities.name: Frost Witch
entities.identity: Builds chill on one target; a threshold briefly freezes it, with control resistance afterward.

entities.name: Sapper Crew
entities.identity: A protected two-person crew plants a timed charge against a structure or fortified target.

entities.name: Outrider
entities.identity: Intercepts the first enemy nearing the wagon, then becomes a fast light melee unit.

entities.name: Mounted Archer
entities.identity: Fires while advancing between shots, then makes one evasive sidestep on contact.

entities.name: Executioner
entities.identity: Heavy swings finish ordinary enemies below a health threshold; bosses take a capped bonus hit.

entities.name: Falconer
entities.identity: A single falcon reveals and marks a distant support enemy for allied focus.

entities.name: Duelist
entities.identity: Parries one telegraphed melee strike, then ripostes into the same enemy.

entities.name: Illusionist
entities.identity: Creates one fragile decoy that redirects eligible enemies for a short window.

entities.name: Chanter
entities.identity: Completes a short chant to advance nearby allies' automatic ability recovery.

entities.name: Trebuchet Crew
entities.identity: Sets up before launching slow siege stones with a wide impact area.

entities.name: Dragon Tamer
entities.identity: Deploys with one small pyre drake; directs a limited cone attack through a marked pack.

entities.name: Grave Rat
entities.identity: Small packs slip around a single isolated blocker.

entities.name: Rustguard
entities.identity: Weak attacks but frontal physical armor; rear or armor-breaking hits expose it.

entities.name: Bellringer
entities.identity: Channels a visible bell call that recruits a small pack; interrupting it prevents the call.

entities.name: Highwayman
entities.identity: A living bandit shoots once, retreats, and then draws a knife.

entities.name: Drowned Harpooner
entities.identity: Telegraphs a harpoon that pulls the foremost allied unit out of formation.

entities.name: Salt Wraith
entities.identity: Briefly phases through a blocker; becomes vulnerable before attacking.

entities.name: Barnacle Guard
entities.identity: A shell plate absorbs a limited number of direct hits before breaking.

entities.name: Hookblade Raider
entities.identity: Runs past a moving frontline to attack a nearby support troop; ordinary blockers still stop it.

entities.name: Ash Hound
entities.identity: Pauses with a bright coal glow before one rapid charge.

entities.name: Cinder Spitter
entities.identity: Its arcing shot leaves a short burning patch instead of persistent unavoidable damage.

entities.name: Furnace Knight
entities.identity: Armor hardens while glowing; cools after its heavy swing.

entities.name: Powder Bandit
entities.identity: Plants a visible powder keg, then retreats; the keg detonates after a delay.

entities.name: Plague Leech
entities.identity: Clings to an enemy tank and grants it limited healing; detaches when the host dies.

entities.name: Miasma Priest
entities.identity: Creates a marked cloud that reduces healing and applies capped blight.

entities.name: Rot Surgeon
entities.identity: Stops to heal one damaged enemy instead of attacking.

entities.name: Sealbreaker
entities.identity: Channels a lance that strips one temporary ward or shield.

entities.name: Cliff Stalker
entities.identity: Crouches before leaping onto a ranged-primary unit.

entities.name: Thorn Brute
entities.identity: Reflects melee contact damage while thorns are raised; drops them after swinging.

entities.name: Briar Witch
entities.identity: Telegraphs a root around one allied troop; damage and cleansing break it early.

entities.name: Avalanche Bearer
entities.identity: Throws a slow stone toward a marked cluster, briefly separating survivors.

entities.name: Chain Penitent
entities.identity: Tethers one frontline ally, limiting how far it can advance until the chain breaks.

entities.name: Ossuary Archer
entities.identity: Its slow spine arrow penetrates the first unit and hurts the next.

entities.name: Bone Cantor
entities.identity: Consumes nearby enemy corpse tokens to raise one tougher servant after a chant.

entities.name: Reliquary Eye
entities.identity: A stationary warded eye opens after releasing a bolt, creating a brief attack window.

entities.name: Swamp Maw
entities.identity: A visible mound waits before erupting beneath an advancing troop.

entities.name: Bog Spore
entities.identity: Bursts into a short blight cloud that also harms nearby enemies.

entities.name: Drowned Colossus
entities.identity: Regenerates slowly inside its own marked water patch; lurches out to attack.

entities.name: Bloated Eel
entities.identity: Makes one sharp dodge of an incoming projectile before committing to melee.

entities.name: Bone Lancer
entities.identity: Winds up a long straight charge that ends on the first solid blocker.

entities.name: Dust Reaver
entities.identity: Alternates a short javelin volley with a vulnerable reload before retreating once.

entities.name: Carrion Banner
entities.identity: Consumes a limited number of enemy corpses to empower its nearby escorts.

entities.name: War Drummer
entities.identity: Channels a drumbeat that advances nearby enemies' attack recovery.

entities.name: Shade
entities.identity: Fades during approach, then becomes targetable before its first strike.

entities.name: Mirror Wisp
entities.identity: Creates one damage-free copy that can draw target locks until hit.

entities.name: Wicker Giant
entities.identity: Resists physical attacks while its wicker shell is intact; burn weakens the shell.

entities.name: Dream Weaver
entities.identity: Marks one support troop for sleep; any damage wakes it, and repeated sleep is resisted.

entities.name: Gate Breaker
entities.identity: Stops to smash a player blocker, causing a small blast behind it; weak against troops away from structures.

entities.name: Crown Executioner
entities.identity: A marked heavy swing wounds one target, briefly reducing healing received.

entities.name: Null Magister
entities.identity: Places a visible null field that suppresses magical ward and spell effects locally.

entities.name: Soul Standard
entities.identity: Stores one elite enemy's soul and returns it once unless the standard is destroyed.

entities.name: Ash Pilgrim
entities.identity: A rare non-attacking traveler offers a visible salvage cache after a brief protected passage.

relics.name: Guardian Shield
relics.special_rule: Add a small deployment shield; trade some raw stats for the effect.

relics.name: War Brand
relics.special_rule: Reward a completed armor break with a brief personal damage window.

relics.name: Windrunner Cloak
relics.special_rule: Reduce slow duration, distinct from periodic cleansing.

relics.name: Sage's Ring
relics.special_rule: After a player spell, advance the wearer's automatic ability recovery on a cooldown.

relics.name: Crown of Valor
relics.special_rule: A qualifying elite kill briefly rallies a few nearby allies.

relics.name: Blade of Ruin
relics.special_rule: Offer a strong periodic hit at a capped health cost that cannot directly kill the wearer.

relics.name: Phantom Mantle
relics.special_rule: Dodge one direct projectile after a visible recharge; area attacks still work.

relics.name: Dragon Heart
relics.special_rule: A low-health threshold emits one small burn pulse per deployment.

relics.name: Wolftooth Charm
relics.special_rule: Add a small benefit while fighting beside another beast troop; keep a useful base effect.

relics.name: Tombstone Shard
relics.special_rule: Restore a little health after a qualifying kill, on a cooldown.

relics.name: Stormcaller Sigil
relics.special_rule: Improve existing chained attacks without granting chains to every weapon.

relics.name: Siege Hammer
relics.special_rule: Keep the current simple stat identity; accurately describe its actual bonuses.

relics.name: Spectral Lantern
relics.special_rule: Weaken nearby blight duration; avoid duplicating Gloam Lantern's stealth reveal.

relics.name: Immortal Wreath
relics.special_rule: Increase healing received while critically wounded rather than promising unconditional immortality.

relics.name: Frostbound Crown
relics.special_rule: Emit a small chill pulse after a completed unit ability, with a cooldown.

relics.name: Moonfire Talisman
relics.special_rule: A qualifying kill empowers one later strike; cannot refresh indefinitely.

relics.name: Hardened Bulwark
relics.special_rule: Cap a fraction of the first heavy direct hit taken each battle.

relics.name: Hardened Fang
relics.special_rule: Reward a successful interrupt with brief real attack recovery acceleration.

relics.name: Hardened Sigil
relics.special_rule: Convert a limited periodic hit to arcane damage; reduce universal stats accordingly.

relics.name: Hardened Crown
relics.special_rule: Extend the wearer's qualifying temporary buffs, with a duration cap.

relics.name: Hardened Soul
relics.special_rule: Gain a capped personal momentum bonus after qualifying kills; resets on death.

relics.name: Grave Lord's Crown
relics.special_rule: A qualifying corpse conversion grants one temporary servant, with a strict summon cap.

relics.name: Iron Warden's Heart
relics.special_rule: Regenerate a small shield only after a safe pause between attacks.

relics.name: Sovereign's Mantle
relics.special_rule: Periodically rally at most a few nearby living allies.

relics.name: Plague Censer
relics.special_rule: A completed unit ability cleanses one nearby blighted ally on a cooldown.

relics.name: Tower Sentinel's Ward
relics.special_rule: A battle-start ward protects against the first marked hazard; retain broad usefulness outside Tower.

relics.name: Ascendant's Signet
relics.special_rule: Participation in a field objective gives a capped personal momentum bonus.

relics.name: Apex Talisman
relics.special_rule: Improve damage against named elites, with no percentage-health boss damage.

relics.name: Pinnacle Crown
relics.special_rule: The first qualifying unit ability repeats once at reduced power; the echo cannot trigger item effects.

relics.name: Rampart Seal
relics.special_rule: Creates a small personal shield on deployment.
relics.limits: Single shield; no refresh from summons.

relics.name: Tower Charm
relics.special_rule: Briefly reduces direct damage while the wearer has remained stationary.
relics.limits: Benefit ends when moving.

relics.name: Last Wall Token
relics.special_rule: Gains temporary defense on crossing a low-health threshold.
relics.limits: Once per deployment; healing cannot repeatedly retrigger it.

relics.name: Iron Prayer
relics.special_rule: Every fourth melee hit restores a little of the wearer's health.
relics.limits: No healing from structures or artificial targets.

relics.name: Sentinel Buckle
relics.special_rule: Grants a ward after successfully intercepting a charge.
relics.limits: Only genuine intercepts qualify; shared internal cooldown.

relics.name: Oathbound Chain
relics.special_rule: Shares a capped portion of received healing with the nearest injured ally.
relics.limits: Shared healing cannot generate another share.

relics.name: Farwatch Lens
relics.special_rule: Increases shot damage with distance up to a modest cap.
relics.limits: No bonus at close range.

relics.name: Windstring
relics.special_rule: Shortens the wearer's first shot windup after deployment.
relics.limits: One activation per deployment.

relics.name: Falcon Feather
relics.special_rule: The first hit marks one target for a short allied focus bonus.
relics.limits: One mark per wearer; marks do not multiply.

relics.name: Huntsman's Knot
relics.special_rule: Boosts damage against an enemy isolated from its allies.
relics.limits: No benefit in dense packs.

relics.name: Trailfinder Boots
relics.special_rule: A qualifying kill grants a brief movement burst.
relics.limits: Cooldown prevents permanent acceleration.

relics.name: Twinbolt Clasp
relics.special_rule: Every fifth ordinary projectile releases a weaker second bolt.
relics.limits: Extra bolts cannot trigger themselves or duplicate summons.

relics.name: Breach Writ
relics.special_rule: The wearer's first structure strike briefly exposes that structure to allied siege damage.
relics.limits: One exposure per structure; cannot make non-siege shots hit bases.

relics.name: Demolition Rune
relics.special_rule: Deals a small secondary blast when the wearer destroys a tactical blocker.
relics.limits: No trigger from timed expiration or friendly dismantling.

relics.name: Counterweight
relics.special_rule: Every third artillery shot has a larger impact area and a longer windup.
relics.limits: Artillery only; no attack-speed stacking shortcut.

relics.name: Gateward Medallion
relics.special_rule: Reduces damage received from marked siege attacks.
relics.limits: No protection against ordinary melee or blight.

relics.name: Sapper's Fuse
relics.special_rule: Leaves one short-fuse bomb when the wearer dies.
relics.limits: Once per instance; revived deaths do not repeat it.

relics.name: Chain Hoist Charm
relics.special_rule: Accelerates a siege unit's advance until its first committed attack.
relics.limits: Bonus ends permanently after setup or attack begins.

relics.name: Cinder Ring
relics.special_rule: Adds a small burn to a periodic successful hit.
relics.limits: Burn stacks are capped and never trigger further on-hit effects.

relics.name: Ashen Rosary
relics.special_rule: Deals bonus damage to burning targets.
relics.limits: Needs another reliable source of burn.

relics.name: Coalglass Vial
relics.special_rule: Extends burns created by the wearer.
relics.limits: Does not extend allied burns or control durations.

relics.name: Fireward Clasp
relics.special_rule: Reduces received burn damage and shortens afterburn.
relics.limits: Does not block direct physical damage.

relics.name: Phoenix Ember
relics.special_rule: The wearer returns once with low health after a short death delay.
relics.limits: Shares the one-revival limit; corpse denial counters it.

relics.name: Hearthstone
relics.special_rule: On deployment, extinguishes burn on a small number of nearby allies.
relics.limits: No global hazard removal or repeated aura cleansing.

relics.name: Rime Needle
relics.special_rule: Every fourth hit applies a brief chill.
relics.limits: Control buildup obeys the target's resistance window.

relics.name: Winter Ribbon
relics.special_rule: Deals bonus damage to chilled or rooted targets.
relics.limits: No bonus against a merely slow-moving unit with no status.

relics.name: Hoarfrost Medal
relics.special_rule: Grants a small shield when the wearer is rooted or slept.
relics.limits: Shield has a long cooldown and does not remove control.

relics.name: Icebound Hourglass
relics.special_rule: A completed unit ability chills its primary target.
relics.limits: Area and summon abilities do not multiply triggers.

relics.name: Glacial Band
relics.special_rule: After the wearer heals an ally, its next attack creates a small chill burst.
relics.limits: Cooldown; shared healing does not trigger it.

relics.name: Thawstone
relics.special_rule: Periodically removes one root or chill from the wearer.
relics.limits: Does not cleanse blight, wounds, or hostile terrain.

relics.name: Mercy Bell
relics.special_rule: Improves the wearer's direct healing of allies at low health.
relics.limits: No effect on lifesteal or terrain healing.

relics.name: Field Surgeon's Badge
relics.special_rule: Healing another ally briefly protects the wearer.
relics.limits: Protection refreshes up to a cap, without stacking.

relics.name: Bloodroot Pendant
relics.special_rule: Heals a small portion of direct damage dealt.
relics.limits: No lifesteal from structures, damage-over-time, or summons.

relics.name: Springwater Charm
relics.special_rule: On deployment, cleanses one blight or wound from the nearest affected ally.
relics.limits: One target; control effects remain.

relics.name: Mender's Thread
relics.special_rule: Converts limited direct overhealing into a temporary shield.
relics.limits: Shield cap; shields do not count as healing.

relics.name: Second Breath Seal
relics.special_rule: Survives one lethal direct hit at one health.
relics.limits: Once per battle per wearer; damage-over-time can still finish it.

relics.name: Nightveil Brooch
relics.special_rule: The wearer begins briefly concealed until it attacks.
relics.limits: Revealing effects and area damage still work.

relics.name: Assassin's Token
relics.special_rule: The first strike against a newly selected enemy gains a small bonus.
relics.limits: Cooldown prevents target-lock manipulation.

relics.name: Grave Silk
relics.special_rule: A qualifying kill seals that corpse against enemy resurrection.
relics.limits: Does not prevent authored split-on-death bodies already released.

relics.name: Umbral Coin
relics.special_rule: A qualifying elite kill returns a small amount of courage.
relics.limits: Per-wearer cooldown; no rewards from player-made targets.

relics.name: Phantom Bell
relics.special_rule: After receiving a direct heal, briefly reduces reflected damage received.
relics.limits: Only reflection; does not reduce the original incoming hit.

relics.name: Moonstep Anklet
relics.special_rule: After completing several attacks, dodges one incoming projectile.
relics.limits: Cooldown and no protection against splash or ground fields.

relics.name: Marshal's Signet
relics.special_rule: Deployment briefly buffs a few nearby allies.
relics.limits: Duplicate signets refresh rather than multiply the same buff.

relics.name: Supply Ledger
relics.special_rule: Returns a small fraction of paid courage after the wearer's first death.
relics.limits: Tracks actual paid cost; never rewards summons or repeated revival.

relics.name: Banner Ribbon
relics.special_rule: Extends the wearer's existing aura radius.
relics.limits: Creates no aura on a unit without one; radius has a cap.

relics.name: Captain's Whistle
relics.special_rule: A completed unit ability can interrupt one channel in a small nearby radius.
relics.limits: Cooldown; no interruption of unmarked ordinary attacks.

relics.name: Caravan Token
relics.special_rule: The wearer's participation in a field objective grants one small supply reward.
relics.limits: One reward per objective for the whole squad, not per copy.

relics.name: King's Commission
relics.special_rule: Gains a limited personal bonus when supported by a nearby ally from a different squad role.
relics.limits: One qualifying partner; no faction-skin requirement.

relics.name: Saint's Reliquary
relics.special_rule: On the wearer's first death, releases one pulse of healing for living allies.
relics.limits: No revival chain; summoned deaths cannot trigger it.

relics.name: Stormglass Prism
relics.special_rule: A periodic direct shot chains a weaker hit to one nearby enemy.
relics.limits: Chain cannot recursively chain or retrigger on-hit items.

relics.name: Earthbind Idol
relics.special_rule: Stationary defenders become resistant to pulls and forced pushes.
relics.limits: No immunity while moving; roots and blight remain.

relics.name: Dragonbone Quiver
relics.special_rule: A periodic arrow pierces one target with reduced damage to the next.
relics.limits: Arrows only; structure eligibility stays unchanged.

relics.name: Emberforge Anvil
relics.special_rule: Heavy melee recovery briefly grants physical armor.
relics.limits: Only after a committed heavy hit; no benefit during windup.

relics.name: Mirror Shard
relics.special_rule: Reflects a capped fraction of direct melee damage received.
relics.limits: Reflected damage cannot reflect again or lifesteal.

relics.name: Gravewarden's Key
relics.special_rule: Periodically seals one nearby enemy corpse before a summoner can consume it.
relics.limits: Limited charges and radius; no erasing live enemies.

relics.name: Tidemaster's Pearl
relics.special_rule: A forced displacement grants a brief movement and attack recovery boost.
relics.limits: Long cooldown; allies cannot farm it with their own movement effects.

relics.name: Sunfall Spur
relics.special_rule: A charge kill advances the wearer's charge recovery once.
relics.limits: Recovery floor and one reward per charge.

relics.name: Gloam Lantern
relics.special_rule: Reveals nearby concealed enemies and identifies the real illusion.
relics.limits: Small radius; no global reveal or automatic damage.

relics.name: Crownroad Charter
relics.special_rule: Completing a supply objective restores a little squad mana.
relics.limits: One payout per objective across all copies.

relics.name: Hollow Chalice
relics.special_rule: Consumes an enemy corpse token to recover the wearer's health.
relics.limits: Competes with friendly summoners; no gain from summoned corpses.

relics.name: Royal Execution Writ
relics.special_rule: A periodic finishing strike removes an ordinary low-health target.
relics.limits: Bosses and protected elites take capped damage instead.

relics.name: Plagueglass Mask
relics.special_rule: Strongly reduces healing penalties from blight and wounds.
relics.limits: Does not remove the status or its other damage.

relics.name: Runic Capacitor
relics.special_rule: Stores limited charges from player spell casts and spends one on the wearer's next hit.
relics.limits: No charge from item procs, copied spells, or refunds.

relics.name: Wandering Shrine
relics.special_rule: After standing safely for a short time, emits a small healing field.
relics.limits: Field ends when moving; only one per wearer.

relics.name: Basilica Hourglass
relics.special_rule: A first lethal hit suspends the wearer briefly; it cannot act until restored with a little health.
relics.limits: Uses the same survival/return allowance as other lethal-save items.

relics.name: Siegebreaker's Crest
relics.special_rule: Improves damage against explicitly fortified enemies.
relics.limits: No universal damage bonus or boss percentage-health burst.

relics.name: Lantern of Dawn
relics.special_rule: Prevents one nearby ally's lethal direct hit and spends its battle charge.
relics.limits: Shared squad limit; cannot protect another Lantern of Dawn trigger.

tactical_items.name: Palisade Kit
tactical_items.effect: Builds a cheap wooden blocker after a short, interruptible setup.
tactical_items.tradeoff: Buys time against rushers; weaker and slower to appear than Stone Barricade.

tactical_items.name: Firepot Mine
tactical_items.effect: A ground trap explodes on the first enemy and leaves a short burning patch.
tactical_items.tradeoff: Area denial; enemies can destroy the visible mine before triggering it.

tactical_items.name: Healing Shrine
tactical_items.effect: A stationary shrine emits a limited number of healing pulses.
tactical_items.tradeoff: Sustained recovery; cannot heal the wagon and can be destroyed.

tactical_items.name: Bolt Turret
tactical_items.effect: A placed bolt-thrower fires a finite number of ordinary shots.
tactical_items.tradeoff: Rear defense; does not attack structures and needs a safe position.

tactical_items.name: Supply Crate
tactical_items.effect: A crate yields small courage packets while allies hold its immediate area.
tactical_items.tradeoff: Trades mana for deployment reserve; enemies can break the crate.

tactical_items.name: Frost Trap
tactical_items.effect: The first enemy triggers a short freeze and consumes the trap.
tactical_items.tradeoff: Stops a dangerous advance; control resistance applies to elites.

tactical_items.name: Decoy Lantern
tactical_items.effect: A placed lantern lures eligible nearby enemies briefly.
tactical_items.tradeoff: Protects supports or gathers a pack; bosses resist and area damage destroys it.

tactical_items.name: Smoke Pot
tactical_items.effect: A small smoke area breaks enemy target locks and conceals moving allies briefly.
tactical_items.tradeoff: Enables retreat or setup; attacks reveal allies and hazards still hurt.

tactical_items.name: Purifying Censer
tactical_items.effect: A temporary field removes one blight or wound per pulse.
tactical_items.tradeoff: Allows healing through plague pressure; does not cleanse the entire battlefield.

tactical_items.name: Repair Cache
tactical_items.effect: A placed cache near the wagon applies a few repair pulses while protected.
tactical_items.tradeoff: Emergency repair; never increases maximum wagon health.

tactical_items.name: Grounding Rod
tactical_items.effect: A placed rod interrupts one marked enemy channel in its radius, then burns out.
tactical_items.tradeoff: Answers a summoner or null cast; must be positioned before completion.

tactical_items.name: War Horn
tactical_items.effect: Marks one enemy near the aimed point as a temporary focus target for eligible allies.
tactical_items.tradeoff: Prioritizes a healer or commander; never forces units through blockers.

enchantments.name: Flame Touch
enchantments.effect: A periodic direct hit applies a small capped burn.

enchantments.name: Lifesteal
enchantments.effect: Heal 8% of eligible direct troop damage; no structures or proc loops.

enchantments.name: Thorns
enchantments.effect: Reflect 15% of eligible direct melee damage; reflected hits cannot reflect again.

enchantments.name: Haste
enchantments.effect: Permanent movement and modest attack cadence improvement.

enchantments.name: Shielding
enchantments.effect: Permanent health and magical resistance improvement.

enchantments.name: Vampiric
enchantments.effect: Heal 5% of eligible direct troop damage.

enchantments.name: Crit Strike
enchantments.effect: Raises critical frequency and bonus separately.

enchantments.name: Poison
enchantments.effect: Periodic hits apply capped blight; no extra critical on the damage over time.

enchantments.name: Fortify
enchantments.effect: More health and armor with a movement tradeoff.

enchantments.name: Arcane Echo
enchantments.effect: A limited unit ability echo cannot trigger itself or refund mana.
